articles.title: US woman killed in rare suspected mountain lion attack
articles.mainIdea: US woman killed in rare suspected mountain lion attack
articles.summary: AFP: US woman killed in rare suspected mountain lion attack. A woman has died after a rare suspected mountain lion attack on a hiking trail in Colorado, an incident that would mark the state's first such fatality in decades if confirmed.Van Hoose stressed that mountain lion attacks are exceedingly rare, with only 28 reported since 1990 in Colorado, and the last fatality in 1999.
